proposals.before: In the thirtieth year, when Shizu entered the capital to attack the prime culprit, he was imprisoned in the Central Secretariat sub-bureau of the palace attendants' office; he was several times on the point of being killed, yet in the end came to no harm.
proposals.after: In the thirtieth year, when Shizu entered the capital to attack the prime culprit, he was imprisoned in the lower office of the Palace Attendants; he was several times on the point of being killed, yet in the end came to no harm.
proposals.reason: 侍中下省 is the lower office of the Palace Attendants, not a Central Secretariat (中書) bureau.

proposals.before: Grand Preceptor Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, stepped down as Director of the Masters of Writing and was named Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; General of Agile Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing.
proposals.after: Grand Preceptor Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, stepped down as Director of the Masters of Writing and was named Supervisor of the Central Secretariat; General of Agile Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing.
proposals.reason: 加中書監 is Supervisor of the Central Secretariat, not another Masters of Writing post.

proposals.before: Grand Preceptor the Prince of Jiangxia, Liu Yigong, was relieved of Director of the Masters of Writing and given the additional post of Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; General of Agile Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was given the additional post of Director of the Masters of Writing.
proposals.after: Grand Preceptor the Prince of Jiangxia, Liu Yigong, was relieved of Director of the Masters of Writing and given the additional post of Supervisor of the Central Secretariat; General of Agile Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was given the additional post of Director of the Masters of Writing.
proposals.reason: The literal likewise renders 中書監 as a Masters of Writing office; it is the Central Secretariat.

proposals.before: General of Agile Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was given the additional title of Grand Master with the Golden Ax and Ceremonies Equal to the Three Dukes.
proposals.after: General of Agile Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was given the additional title of Opening an Office with Ceremonies Equal to the Three Dukes.
proposals.reason: 開府儀同三司 does not include a golden ax; that phrasing invents 斧鉞.

proposals.before: On yichou day Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister over the Masses.
proposals.after: On yichou day Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, General Who Comforts the Army and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister over the Masses.
proposals.reason: 撫軍將軍 is not the same office as 鎮軍將軍, already rendered 'General Who Pacifies the Army' in s0029.

proposals.before: On yichou day Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister over the Masses.
proposals.after: On yichou day Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, General Who Comforts the Army and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister over the Masses.
proposals.reason: The literal copies the same collapse of 撫軍 into the 鎮軍 English title.

proposals.before: On xinchou day in the ninth month, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General Who Protects the Army, was made chief General Who Protects the Army.
proposals.after: On xinchou day in the ninth month, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.
proposals.reason: 為領軍將軍 is a change from 護軍將軍 to 領軍將軍, not a 'chief' grade of the same Protects-the-Army title.

proposals.before: On xinchou day in the ninth month, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Protects the Army in chief.
proposals.after: On xinchou day in the ninth month, Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.

proposals.before: On wuwu day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou; Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, became chief General Who Protects the Army; Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang and Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Inspector of Yuzhou; Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, became Central Army Guard; and Liu Zifang, Prince of Xunyang, was transferred from Southern Yuzhou to Eastern Yang Province.
proposals.after: On wuwu day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou; Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, became General Who Leads the Army; Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang and Supervisor of the Palace Library, was appointed Inspector of Yuzhou; Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, became Central Army Guard; and Liu Zifang, Prince of Xunyang, was transferred from Southern Yuzhou to Eastern Yang Province.
proposals.reason: 為領軍將軍 is not a 'chief' 護軍將軍; 祕書監 is the Palace Library, not the Masters of Writing.

proposals.before: On wuwu day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General Who Protects the Army in chief, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou; Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Protects the Army in chief; Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, was made Inspector of Yuzhou; Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, General of the Left Guard, was made Central Army Guard; Liu Zifang, Prince of Xunyang, Inspector of Southern Yuzhou, was made Inspector of Eastern Yang Province.
proposals.after: On wuwu day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General Who Leads the Army, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou; Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Leads the Army; Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, Supervisor of the Palace Library, was made Inspector of Yuzhou; Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, General of the Left Guard, was made Central Army Guard; Liu Zifang, Prince of Xunyang, Inspector of Southern Yuzhou, was made Inspector of Eastern Yang Province.

proposals.before: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, General Who Protects the Army in chief, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yongzhou; Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General of the Guard, was restored as Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
proposals.after: Liu Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an, General Who Leads the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yongzhou; Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General of the Guard, was restored as Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
proposals.reason: 領軍將軍 is not a graded 護軍將軍; the same error recurs from earlier units.

proposals.before: I hold the three extremities and the winds are clear throughout the realm; with axe and lightning I have cut down the guilty, and at the hour of mao justice was done.
proposals.after: I hold the three extremities and the winds are clear throughout the realm; with axe and lightning I have cut down the guilty, and Zhengmao has now been executed.
proposals.reason: 正卯斯戮 alludes to Shaozheng Mao (少正卯), not to the earthly-branch hour 卯.

proposals.before: I occupy the three extremities and the winds are clear throughout the myriad realms; with axe and lightning I cut off, and at the hour of mao the execution is carried out.
proposals.after: I occupy the three extremities and the winds are clear throughout the myriad realms; with axe and lightning I cut off, and Zhengmao is hereby executed.
proposals.reason: The literal likewise reads 正卯 as the hour 卯 rather than the name in the 少正卯 allusion.

proposals.before: I mean to look up and proclaim the legacy of my forebears and look down to extend the bright fortune of the throne; night after night I dream of the cauldron in the kitchen, and when I think of the plank road I do not forget the hour before dawn.
proposals.after: I mean to look up and proclaim the legacy of my forebears and look down to extend the bright fortune of the throne; night after night I dream of the kitchen cauldron, and when I think of rammed-earth building I do not forget the hour before dawn.
proposals.reason: 板築 is rammed-earth construction (the Fu Yue allusion), not a plank road.

proposals.before: Shen Qingzhi, Duke of Shixing, was appointed Grand Marshal; Wang Xuamo, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was made chief General Who Protects the Army.
proposals.after: Shen Qingzhi, Duke of Shixing, was appointed Grand Marshal; Wang Xuamo, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.

proposals.before: Shen Qingzhi, Duke of Shixing, was made Grand Marshal; Wang Xuamo, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was made General Who Protects the Army in chief.
proposals.after: Shen Qingzhi, Duke of Shixing, was made Grand Marshal; Wang Xuamo, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.

proposals.before: On xinchou day Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was stripped of rank and ordered to take his own life.
proposals.after: On xinchou day Liu Ziluan, Prince of Xin'an, General Who Comforts the Army and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was stripped of rank and ordered to take his own life.

proposals.before: On dingwei day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General of the Guard, was given the additional title of Grand Master with the Golden Ax and Ceremonies Equal to the Three Dukes; Liu Zunkao, Special Advance and Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou; Yin Xiaozu, General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, was made Inspector of Yanzhou.
proposals.after: On dingwei day Liu Yu, Prince of Xiangdong, General of the Guard, was given the additional title of Opening an Office with Ceremonies Equal to the Three Dukes; Liu Zunkao, Special Advance and Right Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou; Yin Xiaozu, General Who Pacifies the Barbarians of the North, was made Inspector of Yanzhou.

proposals.before: On xinhai day Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, General of the Right and Inspector of Yuzhou, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
proposals.after: On xinhai day Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, General of the Right and Inspector of Yuzhou, was promoted to General-in-chief Who Stabilizes the West.

proposals.before: On yiyou day Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yuzhou, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and given the title of Grand Master with the Golden Ax and Ceremonies Equal to the Three Dukes.
proposals.after: On yiyou day Liu Xiuyou, Prince of Shanyang, General-in-chief Who Stabilizes the West and Inspector of Yuzhou, was made General-in-chief Who Pacifies the Army and given the title of Opening an Office with Ceremonies Equal to the Three Dukes.
proposals.reason: Again 開府儀同三司 is padded with a golden ax, and 鎮西/鎮軍 are flattened to 'Pacifies'.
